scenario: 今天检索赛道的主线，是检索结果进了大模型之后怎么才算可靠。一项测试发现，模型对上下文里给出的关系推理，到分析层就明显变差；另一项研究追踪到提示里的无关内容，是靠少数注意力头干扰了答案。Weaver 和 ArcRAG 分别在个性化记忆和知识图谱上改进检索，CacheGraft 让小模型直接读融合后的 KV cache。另有一个框架用来评估自主搜索策略，一个跨模态检索方法同时处理缺失模态和标签噪声。

papers.title: Semantic Prior-Guided Incomplete Cross-Modal Retrieval with Noisy Labels
papers.authors: Jiali Chen, Ruitao Pu, Yingke Chen, Dezhong Peng
papers.abstract: Cross-modal retrieval (CMR) aims to bridge the semantic gaps between modalities by learning shared representations. Unfortunately, due to the dynamism and inconsistencies in real-world data acquisition, multimodal datasets frequently encounter severe modality incompleteness. Existing incomplete CMR methods adhere to a label-driven paradigm, relying heavily on categorical annotations as the semantic benchmark. However, label noise is difficult to avoid and often coexists with modality incompleteness. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semantic prior-guided framework for incomplete cross-modal retrieval with noisy labels, termed SPIRN. Specifically, SPIRN uses fixed semantic priors as a consistent reference for robust representation learning, noisy-label handling, and missing-modality completion. Based on this reference, Semantic Priors Guidance (SPG) establishes a stable category-level semantic space, Quality-aware Robust Learning (QRL) dynamically evaluates sample quality to
papers.summary: 用文字搜图、用图搜文字这类跨模态检索，训练数据常缺一种模态（比如有的样本只有图），类别标签还带错。已有方法都把标签当语义基准，标签一错，补出来的内容也跟着错。SPIRN 给每个类别设一个固定、互相正交的语义参照向量，训练中不更新。样本离自己标签的参照向量越近，越被当作干净样本、权重越大。训练一段后，每个样本的标签都改成最相似参照向量的类别。缺失的模态，用已有模态在存着完整样本的记忆库里找最相近的样本，把它们另一模态的表示按相似度加权平均；补出的表示越贴近所属类别的参照向量，把握越大。一开始只用把握大的补全，之后逐步放进把握稍低的。在四个数据集的大多数设置下超过 11 个已有方法。

papers.title: Interpretable Text Embeddings Based on Hierarchical Questions
papers.authors: Kohei Oda, Po-Min Chuang, Kiyoaki Shirai, Natthawut Kertkeidkachorn
papers.abstract: QA-based text embeddings represent texts as vectors consisting of 1/0 answers to yes/no questions. Although these embeddings provide detailed information for interpretation and achieve high task performance, they often require humans to examine a large number of questions. Furthermore, the relationship between the number of questions and the appropriate level of question granularity has not been sufficiently studied. To address these challenges, we propose a method for constructing hierarchical questions for text embeddings. As the hierarchy deepens, questions become more specific and their number increases. During interpretation, we reduce the number of questions that humans need to examine by replacing questions at deeper levels with aligned questions at shallower levels. The question hierarchy is constructed through recursive clustering, contrastive prompting, and question alignment. Experimental results on general-purpose tasks show that our method improves interpretability while m
papers.summary: 把文字表示成对一串是非问题的是或否回答，是一种每一维都能读懂的 embedding，但问题成百上千，人看不过来。这篇论文给问题建层次，让人只读少量概括的问题就能解释，任务效果基本保持。问题这样得到：先把大规模文本聚成几大类，让大模型对比各类，写出能区分它们的问题；每个大类再聚成更小的类，同样写问题，所以浅层问题概括，深层问题具体，数量也更多。每个深层问题挂到意思更宽的浅层问题下面（示意：问是否谈到跑步的问题，挂在问是否谈到运动的问题下）。论文还发现，问题数量相同时，浅层问题得到的 embedding 比深层问题效果更好。

papers.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
papers.authors: Zohreh Abbasi Liasi, Batoul Hammoud, Anas Madkoor, Ehsaneddin Asgari
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even
papers.summary: RAG 默认模型会按上下文里给出的关系去推理，而不是回头用预训练时记住的联想。这篇论文把这件事单独测：事实直接放进提示词，不做检索。题目从 Wikidata 的关系出发，按记忆、理解、应用、分析、评价五个层级出选择题，在几十个模型、六种语言上测。分析层要对照给出的事实排除相近的错误关系，评价层要判断哪个说法才是该关系的定义标准，光对照事实排除不了干扰项。结果是，从应用层到分析层，准确率断崖式下跌，每个开源模型系列都是如此，最多跌 47.2 个点，两个 Gemini 模型则不会。评价层更是瓶颈，Gemini 3.1 Pro 在其他四层平均 99.5%，评价层只有 60.7%。模型更强，并不保证能可靠地依据你给的证据推理。

papers.title: A Sequential Decision Framework for Evaluating LLM-Guided Search
papers.authors: Siqing Huo, Andrew Parry, Debasis Ganguly, Mark Smucker, Charles L. A. Clarke
papers.abstract: Recent systems applying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and "deep research" iteratively generate queries, retrieve documents, and examine their contents, using the resulting information to guide subsequent search steps. When this process is carried out autonomously rather than by a human searcher, the system must make explicit decisions about which search trajectories to explore and what objective the search is intended to optimize. We introduce a simple framework for reasoning about such search policies, providing a principled approach to evaluation. The framework models the search environment as a set of ranked lists and represents behavior using two primitive actions: select, which advances judgment through an existing ranking, and spawn, which generates a new ranking through query generation or reformulation. Each action produces a document to inspect, yields information that updates the search state, and contributes a reward for a task-specific objective. Within this abstraction, a variety of existing retrieval strategies can be expressed as policies operating over a common environment, while common retrieval objectives can be represented through reward and weighting functions over the resulting search trajectory, and the resulting formulation admits a natural reinforcement learning interpretation. We illustrate the approach using high-recall information retrieval (HRIR), where the goal is to identify as many relevant documents as possible with limited judging effort, showing how the framework provides a unified way to describe and reason about strategies for both classical retrieval tasks and emerging LLM-guided search systems. Through experiments, we demonstrate that both the underlying retrieval method and the "deep research" policy employed can materially affect performance.
papers.summary: RAG 和深度研究类系统会自己反复生成查询、检索、读文档，再决定下一步搜什么，但这类自主搜索策略缺少统一的评估方式。这篇论文给了一个简单框架：把搜索环境看成一组排好序的列表，策略只有两个动作，一个是在已有列表里继续往下判断文档，一个是靠生成或改写查询新开一个列表。每个动作都带来一篇要检查的文档，文档里的信息更新搜索状态，同时按任务目标（比如找到相关文档）记一份奖励，所以各种已有检索策略和检索目标都能放进同一套描述。在高召回检索上的实验显示，底层检索方法和深度研究策略都会明显影响效果。

papers.title: Weaver: Weaving Preference Evidence through Incremental Reasoning for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Linyao Zheng, Zhifang Mao, Xuhang Shi
papers.abstract: Personalized retrieval-augmented generation requires extracting and applying user preferences from extended interaction histories. This task is challenging because preference evidence is scattered across past conversations and remains bound to specific temporal and situational contexts. Consequently, isolated fragments rarely provide complete support for a response, while preferences expressed under different conditions are easily conflated. To address these limitations, we propose Weaver, a framework that incrementally weaves memory-conditioned retrieval trajectories with compositional preference reasoning for personalized responses. Weaver operates on a Dual-Layer Retrieval and Reasoning Graph that couples an upper Intent Dependency Graph with a lower Memory-Conditioned Retrieval Trajectory Graph. Dependency Information Gap Tracking represents the information needed to answer the current request and its prerequisite dependencies in the upper graph. Memory-Conditioned Incremental Retr
papers.summary: 个性化 RAG 要从很长的历史对话里找出用户偏好，难在两点：证据散落在不同对话里，单个片段不完整；偏好又依赖时间和场景，容易被混在一起。Weaver 先让大模型把当前请求拆成相互依赖的子问题，每个子问题还缺的信息就是一个缺口（例如请求是推荐活动，可拆成他偏好什么活动场所、他在人多的地方感受如何）。每找到一条线索，就用它去定位下一处缺失的证据，而不是一次检索完。再综合证据，判断哪些偏好适用于当前场景、哪些互相冲突，并更新还缺什么。在 PersonaMem 上准确率为 86.42%，比最强基线高 16.01 个百分点，在 PrefEval 上为 91.10%。

papers.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Jyotin Goel, Abhinav Arun, Tejas Prakash Agarwal, Bhaskarjit Sarmah, Stefano Pasquali
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the r
papers.summary: GraphRAG 的检索策略通常和自己的建图流程绑在一起，换一种建图方式还有没有效，很少有人测过。这篇论文发现，检索不一定要和图一起设计。ArcRAG 在回答问题时，从问题里提到的实体出发，现场整理出能走到的节点标签、关系描述和属性名，据此规划多跳查询，写成 Cypher 执行，出错再修复。同一套检索配置，在有类型和封闭关系集的图上，以及在开放信息抽取得到的无类型图上，都能用。开放图上 MuSiQue 的 EM 为 38.0，比结构化的图低 6.0；结构化的图上为 44.0，高于论文表里已报告的所有系统。建图方式仍会影响绝对准确率。

papers.title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
papers.authors: Vihan Lakshman, Peter Baile Chen, Zhuohan Gu, Michael Cafarella
papers.abstract: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. Across five QA benchmarks and two independent locally-run judges, CacheGraft improves answer quality over the text-only receiver baseline in 29 out of 30 comparisons, of which 17 of the 30 are stati
papers.summary: 小模型做 RAG 受限于理解能力，让大模型在线读文档又太贵。CacheGraft 的做法是离线、每个语料段落只做一次：借用已有的 Cache-to-Cache 融合方法：一个训练好的融合网络逐层把大模型读这段文字得到的 KV cache 并入小模型自己读它得到的 cache，结果落在小模型的 KV 空间里，存起来备用。查询时，按 embedding 相似度选出相关段落，小模型直接加载它的融合 cache，问题仍以文字输入，在线不需要大模型。在五个问答基准上，无论用检索到的第一名段落还是标准答案所在段落，按两个 LLM 评审和是否包含正确答案三种口径，30 组对比里有 29 组好于只读文本的小模型，最多高约 8 个百分点，而融合器从没用检索数据训练过。只能部署小模型的场景可以参考。

papers.title: The Intrusion Pathway: How Non-Evidential Context Degrades Language Model Performance
papers.authors: Dikshant Kukreja, Gautam Gupta, Avni Mittal, Avinash Anand, Kritarth Prasad, Zhengkui Wang, Timothy Liu, Rajiv Ratn Shah, Aik Beng Ng, Simon See, Erik Cambria
papers.abstract: Language models lose accuracy when a prompt contains non-evidential context: irrelevant statements from unrelated domains, or random off-distribution tokens, with no competing answer and no semantic overlap with the query. Such noise pervades retrieval-augmented, tool-using, and long-context deployments, yet the failure has lacked a mechanistic account. We trace the corruption to the Intrusion Pathway, which starts with MLPs enriching both query-subject and irrelevant-token representations, parroting heads carry prefix-token content to the prediction position, and relational readers largely avoid unrelated sources. Nevertheless, preserved subject enrichment and selective reading do not prevent intrusion in the broader computation. We then localize part of this interference to a sparse set of attention heads, which we call intrusion heads. Their prefix-derived writes promote distractor-related content, while their reduced support for the correct answer arises primarily from weaker non-p
papers.summary: 提示里混进和问题无关的内容，比如不相关领域的陈述或随机 token，会让模型答错，RAG、工具调用、长上下文里都常见，但原因一直没讲清。这篇论文在模型内部追踪出一条干扰路径，并找到少数注意力头（本文称干扰头）：它们把无关内容写进预测位置，推高和干扰项相关的内容，正确答案得到的支持随之变弱。干扰头和负责整合有用上下文的头基本不重合。把最后一个 token 被污染的表示换成干净版本，平均能追回干扰造成的准确率下降的 97.6%，但这需要多跑一遍干净输入，上线用不了。可部署的做法是关掉约十个干扰头，约占全部注意力头的 1%，能追回同一个下降的 57%。

papers.title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
papers.authors: Xinyu Yang, Jiejun Tan, Chenlong Deng, Chenghao Zhang, Tongyu Wen, Zhicheng Dou
papers.abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubri
papers.summary: 法律判决预测要先检索法条和判例，但现有的法律搜索 agent 常直接拿案情当查询，漏掉潜在的法律问题和关键细节。LegalEvolver 训练模型写出信息量更足的查询。它先高温采样多样的检索轨迹，再改写其中的查询，补进案情里的行为、后果等关键事实，或按哪一步没做对，转去查构成要件、量刑档次，挑出成功的轨迹做监督微调。接着对比同一案件里成功和失败的轨迹，让大模型总结出评价查询好坏的评分细则。强化学习时，细则给每次查询打分，和判决对错的奖励一起用，每轮后用新轨迹更新细则。有细则指导优于直接 SFT 加 RL，会更新的细则又优于固定的细则。

papers.title: Domain-specific information retrieval
papers.authors: Suzan Verberne, Florina Piroi, Allan Hanbury
papers.abstract: Information Retrieval (IR) is much more than ad hoc web search: a large portion of the information seeking activities takes place in specific domains, often addressing work-related tasks. Examples are lawyers finding relevant prior cases for a legal case and academic researchers studying the background material for a paper. In Chapter 2 we outline the most common domain-specific tasks, datasets and applications. Domain-specific IR has a number of challenges that make set it apart from simple web search tasks: they often deal with long documents, long queries and long sessions with specific user needs. We discuss these in Chapter 3. We also address issues related to bias and fairness of models. In Chapter 4, we describe the models and methods developed for domain-specific tasks and data, addressing the specific challenges, including user aspects related to domain-specific IR tasks, dealing with queries, user models, and user interactions. We show that many of the methodological advances
papers.summary: 律师找判例、研究者查背景文献这类专业领域的检索，和网页搜索很不一样：文档长、查询长、会话也长，用户的需求又很具体。这是一本关于领域检索的综述专著。它先梳理最常见的领域任务、数据集和应用，再讨论这些特点带来的挑战，以及模型的偏见和公平问题，最后介绍针对这些挑战发展出的模型和方法，包括查询处理、用户模型和用户交互。作者的结论之一是，领域检索里的不少方法进展可以迁移到其他领域，甚至开放域的网页搜索。
